title: Repository Estate Registration
description: Schema for a durable repository registration record in the Repository Estate evidence domain. Content-light: all identity fields are digests or counts — never raw file contents, raw paths, or secrets.

repository_hash.description: Stable opaque repository identifier. Derived from path digest + common-dir digest for local-only repos; remote-derived for GitHub-backed.

repository_label.description: Human-readable label (directory name or GitHub owner/repo).

root_path_digest.description: SHA256 hex digest of the resolved repository root path.

git_common_dir_digest.description: Content-based digest of .git/common directory. Primary correlation signal for idempotent re-registration.

remote_identity_digest.description: Remote-derived digest for GitHub-backed repos. Stable reconciliation signal.

last_registered_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of most recent registration or reconciliation.

latest_observation_digest.description: SHA256 hex digest of the most recent observation payload.

latest_observation_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent observation.
